changelog.note: 231 (stage U, U-A7; the owner's decision of 2026-10-28): the protection the real product's rules ask for: whether the site is an inland water area, how the alarm is maintained, the guarding, the alarm's remote signalling (as printed), and each asset group's insurance basis. A new question: every earlier answer is asked again.

231 (stage U, U-A6; the paid round on the real product's invented customers): the flood zone word for word as printed, never put into the invented insurer's scale (the model put the real product's flood area classes into that scale or left them out). A new question.

231 (stage U, U-A6): the protection class as printed, a number (3) or a Roman numeral (IV), as the real product's protection rules number their classes VII to I; a text field. A new question: every earlier answer is asked again.

231 (U-A0; the D-h measurement): an asset group whose name is none of the listed ones is a row too, copied as printed, never left out (the paid round left out a schedule's fifth row, an unlisted group). A new GPT request: its earlier answers are asked again.

231 (stage D, D-e1; the owner's decision of 2026-10-26: a new detection type of its own): the property schedule of one insured site, under the detection type insurance_application. G path only. The site's address, size, flood zone and protection, and its asset groups (one row each) with their sum insured, valuation basis and wear. One schedule per site, as a list cannot hold another list.
